notes.title: You don't know the game secret!(Online mode is about to launch)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/7153f177e82ff60e9f217876644c8fabc9df9861.jpg[/img]
We'd like to introduce some of the secrets of the game:
1.Build a machine and set the robot behind a sandbag to defend it. It can make the robot better defense to zombie attacks, thus maintaining a smooth output.
2.The resource pick-up point will be refreshed every other time and can be picked up again.
3.Bury the landmines on the ground next to the scarecrow, and the scarecrow will attract the zombies and trigger the explosion
4.In the face of the zombie siege, the combination of energy shield and shotguns can protect yourself ，quickly remove the zombie.
5.If the zombie is close to you, use an energy shield to push the zombie around.
6.The base can restore life free of charge, but make sure there are no zombies near the base
7.Use a spacer to pick up objects that can't be touched, such as some architectural blueprints.
8.The fortifications are built in the blink of an eye. If there is a zombie in the building, it will be crushed when it is built
9.It is easier to cut down dead bodies of cold weapons
10.The early robots are vulnerable, protecting the robot, and protecting the robot to upgrade to level 3, so that they can be on their own.

Online mode is about to launch!!!

notes.title: Version 0.3.1 updates
notes.content:
Contents added:
1. Added a new level "city cry".
2. Three kinds of resources (metal, flammable and wastes) can be collected and used to build equipment and fortifications.
3. Up to 5 up-gradable robots can be built to help fight.
4. Can build automatic machine gun turret, automatic howitzer turret, straw-man with the help of blueprint.
5. The fortifications at each intersection can be rebuilt after being destroyed.
6. Recovery bin at the base can restore the player's HP.
7. Added six zombies and a Boss.
8. A new set of UI is used in the new scenario.
9. Added a Telekinesis to pick up props from a distance.
10. Added the energy shield model with function to push approaching zombies.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/89975c574060866e52a9939e979d0c48a506d846.png[/img]

Optimized contents:
1. Optimized the moving effects..
2. Optimized oil drum explosion effects with more strength.
3.Optimized the animation of zombie walking, being injured and dying ; head being exploded, being blasted, and being hit fly in particular.
4. Optimized the AI of zombies to hit targets with deadliest hate.
5. The store is simplified, easier to operate and clearer to display, but only in the new scene.
6. The backpack is simplified, one-key acquired, but in the new scene.
7. Grenade throwing optimization.
8. Setting bomb optimization.
9. Optimized the energy shield model. 
10. Optimized the hands model.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/30c19c08ae8b7f5d13b70a76f55b2b3d8cd90097.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/aa9b904b504ec3332458e9673386e367495e7da8.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/298d81274b363c9fa7234ae1f5b156f25d68098c.png[/img]

notes.title: Fortifications introduction
notes.content:
[b]Sandbag[/b]
Basic fortifications, sandbags can block the zombie walk. But sandbags are not strong, it's easy to break, so you'll have to build it in time.

[b]Wire Sandbag[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/8570bbcd84cc361cb8c1a2c9f4f0c0d5b31b6045.jpg[/img]
Stronger than sandbag, and it can cause injury to the zombie,but can't for Big zombie.

[b]Scarecrow[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/b5b3020c6180aa8d9e960b6d1308ee324e8952ae.jpg[/img]
The scarecrow has a smell of blood, can make sounds. It can be used as bait!

[b]Explosion Scarecrow[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/9520a2072e6621940d66283766811388a05bf073.jpg[/img]
It has bombs in his body,you'll see it!

[b]Automatic emplacement[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/52078a469e168e4c70f681489905d61f12f59a9b.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/9a28104bb827a1d360b6ffd7e917a17e1e1f097e.jpg[/img]
Automatic battery locking program allows them to accurately identify who is their own master，who is a group of detestable zombies. Destroying all the zombies that appear in its vision is its only mission. 
It has several features like the spleen of the power of a rainy night, infinite "the rate of fire of Spring Festival, fragile durability.

Treatment Room
Can help you recover your Health Point, But when zombies get closer to room, It's going to be completely paralyzed.
you have to kill the zombie near it,and it can function again.

notes.title: New Level New Gameplay
notes.content:
[b]New Level: City Cry[/b]
One the night city streets, withbright lights , but no vitality, only came the animal-likelowroar between whiles.
A group of the cursed undead, wandering in the deserted streets, searching for the breathing of the living to taste the blood.
You've been exiled here by the mysterious God, and will go through a new life and death test!
Between life and death, are you looking for a slim chance of survival? Or sinking in the everlasting sleepby their assimilation?
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/b5b3020c6180aa8d9e960b6d1308ee324e8952ae.jpg[/img]

[b]New Gameplay: material collection[/b]
Join the material collection system, the city is filled with a variety of available materials.
These materials are scrap metals, combustibles, waste materials.
These materials can be used to build all kinds of firearms, firearms modules, explosives, fortifications, auto turrets, robot squad, etc..
In addition, killing zombies will provide the probability of obtaining materials.
If you want to survive at this cruel night, go and collect more materials.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/53e23e9c332193ebc2f18ad90331d0f0de47acf0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: NEW VERSION,EXPECT TO LUNCH BEFORE NOVEMBER 30!!!
notes.content:
[b] Make your robot team[/b]
you can make your robot team,let help defend!!!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/22ce2270c51e3b963b2f4bac0b3cd8d29db4b02e.jpg[/img]

[b] Five quotas are available[/b]
Five quotas are available,but in the last time,you need find more an more resource.
robot isn't invincible, if they were destroyed,you need make new.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/77b96b2555a164dcf14af024f219c9bedab8db0e.jpg[/img]

[b] Update[/b]
Different from UAV,robots need to be update by killing,after update,robots get more HP,more POW,more AGI.Robots highest level 8,will be strong!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/c05654a60e3f39d7a1f025458bd2b526027f8182.jpg[/img]

[b] Robots instruction[/b]
Robots instruction:Follow,Defense,Patrol.
Follow:follow the player and move around the player;
Defense:select fixed position,destroy all zombies that pass through this location;
Patrol:looking for a line,patrol back and forth.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/539e9d3ab8828f5ef1c60a048f8fa276c52e6dd3.jpg[/img]

[b] Robot repair and death[/b]
After the robot was destroyed,become level 0,so to watch a robot,remember to repair.
When you get "Blueprint"(we will tell you in next letter) ,robots explode when they die,destroy the zombies around robots.
When a robot is injured,you can repair it,but repair need money.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/6bc71d6784bdd6645bca99cbd0ef158e36e5ff53.jpg[/img]
